scenarios.description: A2: edits inside paths, no push, no merge, no unlisted egress
A3: push to feature branches and open PRs; no merge, no protected branches
A4: auto-merge inside limits and paths; governance files stay protected
A4: auto-merge denied when the diff exceeds max_diff_lines
A4: auto-merge denied when the diff touches a path outside permitted paths
Grant 4 under a cap of 2 behaves as level 2
A stop test older than 30 days drops a level-4 workflow to level 2
A demotion override of 3 blocks merging
A changed harness hash caps the grant at 3 until the task bank passes
Session read untrusted input and holds sensitive data: external action denied
Same workflow, no untrusted input read yet: external action allowed
A named deterministic gate allows the external action
A1: read-only
A1 with no tool allowlist: plain read-only commands joined by | pass; write-capable flags, wrappers, quoting and substitutions are denied
A1: shell expansions that rebuild a write flag after the check (ANSI-C quoting, parameter and brace expansion, globs, here-documents, process substitution) are denied
A workflow missing from the register gets read-only tools
A2 without a network allowlist cannot reach any host
A2: shell writes to locked paths through find -delete, ln, rsync, cp -t, install, truncate, dd, tar, unzip, --output and sort -o are denied; a person opens the pull request
A3 without a network allowlist is not egress restricted
Wrappers, inline interpreters, odd paths and config files do not get past the hook
